sketches.study_axis: gentle moving phase cancellation; exposed phase range
sketches.intent: r2 moves the phase transition into the source's harmonics, broadens it and balances Dry against the actual wet level. Same r1 MIDI, oscillator/FM/amp settings, type/mode and unchanged Ripple DSP. Fixed output trims recover wet attenuation; matched comparisons remove gain. Independent Ripple-inspired implementation, not Pigments equivalence or factory approval.
